insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (Sum Insured is as per Schedule)

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre -existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.reference: Section C.I.iii) Pre-Existing Diseases (Code – Excl01), Page 13
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases and their direct complications are not covered for the first 36 months of continuous coverage from the first policy start date. Claims for PEDs become payable only after you complete 3 years without a break.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.reference: Section C.I.i) 30-day Waiting period (Code – Excl03), Page 11
good.explanation: Illness-related treatment is not covered in the first 30 days from policy commencement, except if the claim arises due to an accident. This means you should not expect coverage for non-accident illnesses in the first month.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments as mentioned in the table below shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Section C.I.ii) Specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code – Excl02), Page 11
good.explanation: The listed specified diseases/procedures are not covered until you complete 24 months of continuous coverage. Claims for those listed items will be payable only after 2 years.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Domiciliary treatment is included as a covered benefit as per the policy terms. This can help when treatment is taken at home instead of a hospital (subject to the policy’s conditions).

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Pre-Hospitalization Medical expenses for consultations, investigations and medicines incurred upto 30 days before Hospitalisation.
good.explanation: Consultations, investigations and medicines are covered for up to 30 days before hospitalization. This helps reimburse diagnostic and doctor costs leading up to admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Post-Hospitalization Medical expenses for consultations, investigations and medicines incurred upto 60 days after discharge from Hospitalisation.
good.explanation: Consultations, investigations and medicines are covered for up to 60 days after discharge. This supports follow-up care costs after hospitalization, but only within the 60-day window.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Shared Accommodation... 15% ... Single occupancy or any higher accommodation type 30% ... If a claim has been admitted... then, the insured person shall bear 30% ... A Co-payment of 15% shall be applicable to all Day Care Procedures
bad.reference: Section B.III (Special terms and conditions) Co-Payment, Page 9-10
bad.explanation: A co-payment applies, including 15% for shared accommodation and 30% for single occupancy or higher, and 15% for all day care procedures. This means you must pay part of every admissible bill yourself, which can materially increase out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Ambulance Cover
bad.quote: Emergency Ambulance: Expenses incurred on an ambulance in an emergency, subject to Rs. 2000 per Hospitalisation.
bad.explanation: Emergency ambulance expenses are covered only up to ₹2,000 per hospitalization. Any ambulance cost above ₹2,000 will be paid by you.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: No restore/reinstatement benefit wording found in the provided document.
bad.reference: Not mentioned in provided Policy Wording extract
bad.explanation: No restore/reinstatement benefit is stated in the provided extract. This means once the sum insured is exhausted, you should not expect automatic refill for further claims in the same policy year.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Annexure I – List of Non-Medical Expenses ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 68 VASOFIX SAFETY
bad.reference: Annexure I – List of Non-Medical Expenses, Page 31-32
bad.explanation: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure I (e.g., gloves, masks, vasofix) are not payable. This can increase your out-of-pocket spend during hospitalization even when the main treatment is covered.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus
bad.quote: No Claim Discount - A 5% non-cumulative discount will be offered on the renewal premium payable under the Policy after every CLAIM FREE Policy Year
bad.explanation: A 5% non-cumulative premium discount is offered on renewal after every claim-free policy year. This reduces premium but does not increase your sum insured over time.

unclear.name: Room Rent
unclear.quote: In-patient Treatment means ... includes Hospital room rent or boarding expenses...
unclear.reference: Important terms You should know, Page 8-9
unclear.explanation: Hospital room rent/boarding is included under in-patient treatment, but no room category or rupee cap is stated in the provided extract. Your actual eligibility (e.g., shared/single room or any cap) may be specified elsewhere such as the policy schedule.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
